sources.snippet: Training: a 30M-parameter model on ~1B TinyStories tokens in 2 h 27 min at 56% MFU. HTTP server: OpenAI-compatible, with streaming. Past capacity it rejects requests with a 429, so time to first token stays bounded, where vLLM's and llama.cpp's grow with the queue (vs vLLM and llama.cpp).
